text: To pay your credit card bill: 1. Log in to HDFC Bank NetBanking at https://netbanking.hdfcbank.com 2. Go to Cards > Pay Bill 3. Enter the amount and click Pay 4. Enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number to authorise. We will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password on a call or SMS.

Activate your new SBI debit card: Visit any SBI ATM, insert the card, select Green PIN and enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number to set your PIN. Do not share your PIN with anyone, including bank staff.

Security tips from Axis Bank: Never share your OTP, PIN, CVV or password with anyone. Axis Bank will never call you to ask for these. If you receive a suspicious call, hang up and report it at https://www.axisbank.com/security or call 1860 500 5555.
Your autopay mandate request of Rs 649 from Netflix is pending. Open the PhonePe app, go to Notifications and approve the request by entering your UPI PIN. This request expires in 24 hours. -PhonePe

Complete your UPI registration: open the Google Pay app, add your bank account, and set your UPI PIN by entering the last six digits of your debit card and its expiry date. Never share these details with anyone.

How to e-verify your ITR: log in to https://www.incometax.gov.in, go to e-File > Income Tax Returns > e-Verify Returns, choose Aadhaar OTP and enter the OTP received on your Aadhaar-linked mobile number. The last date is 30 days from filing. -Income Tax Department

To activate your UAN: visit https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in, click Activate UAN, enter your UAN, Aadhaar, name and date of birth, then enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number. -EPFO

Dear customer, complete your SIM re-verification: visit your nearest Airtel store with Aadhaar, or use the Airtel Thanks app: open the app, tap Profile > Re-verify and enter the OTP received on your number. Calls will not be affected before 30 Nov. -Airtel

To return your Flipkart order: open the Flipkart app, go to My Orders, select the item and tap Return. Pickup will be arranged within 2 days. Refund is issued after pickup. Never share your OTP with the delivery agent for returns.

Your policy renewal is due. To renew online: go to https://www.hdfclife.com, click Pay Premium, enter your policy number and date of birth, and pay by UPI, card or net banking. Keep your policy number handy. -HDFC Life

Dear Customer, as per RBI guidelines, you must update your nominee details. Log in to ICICI iMobile Pay > Services > Nominee Registration and enter the nominee's name and relationship. Alternatively visit your branch. Ignore if already done.

Your ICICI Bank NetBanking login is now more secure. From 1 Dec, you will need to verify with an OTP sent to your registered mobile number at every login on a new device. Visit https://www.icicibank.com for details.

Link your Aadhaar with your PAN: visit https://www.incometax.gov.in, click Link Aadhaar, enter your PAN and Aadhaar number and validate with the OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile. The last date is 31 Dec. A fee of Rs 1,000 applies after the deadline.
Passport Seva: To book an appointment, log in at https://www.passportindia.gov.in with your registered ID and password, select the application and pay the fee online. Do not pay anyone else. -MEA

Dear Customer, your fixed deposit of Rs 2,00,000 matures on 12 Nov. To renew or withdraw, log in to Kotak NetBanking or visit your branch. If we do not hear from you the deposit will be auto-renewed for the same tenure. -Kotak Mahindra Bank

Dear Customer, a standing instruction on your account failed due to insufficient balance. Please ensure your account has funds by 5 Nov to avoid a returned instruction charge of Rs 250 plus GST. -Bank of Baroda

Dear Consumer, your electricity connection will be disconnected on 10 Nov if the pending bill of Rs 2,340 is not paid. Pay at https://www.bescom.co.in or at the nearest BESCOM office. Customer care 1912. -BESCOM
Dear Customer, your Jio number will be deactivated on 30 Nov unless you complete KYC. Visit the nearest Jio store or use the MyJio app: open the app, tap Complete KYC and follow the steps. -Jio

Zerodha: To reset your Kite password, go to https://kite.zerodha.com, click Forgot password, enter your user ID and PAN, and enter the TOTP. Zerodha will never ask for your password or TOTP over phone or email.

Dear student, to download your hall ticket log in to https://examportal.vit.edu with your registration number and date of birth. Carry a printout and a photo ID. The exam begins at 9:30 AM sharp. -Exam Cell

URGENT: your SBI account will be frozen if KYC is not updated by 31 Dec. Visit your nearest branch with Aadhaar and PAN. SBI never asks for KYC details over SMS or call. Report fraud at https://cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
To get your FASTag recharged: open the Paytm app, go to FASTag, select your vehicle and add money by UPI. Balance updates within 30 minutes. For support call 1800 120 4210.
Your lab report is ready. To download: open the Apollo 24/7 app, go to Reports and enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number. Reports are available for 90 days.

Block your lost card: log in to the Yes Bank app > Cards > Block Card, or call 1800 1200 anytime. After blocking, enter the OTP received on your registered number to confirm. Never share this OTP with anyone.

Amazon: your account password was changed. If this was not you, reset it now at https://www.amazon.in/ap/forgotpassword or contact us at https://www.amazon.in/contact-us. We will never ask you for your password or OTP over the phone.
